Alexei Morozov  
Tel Aviv, Israel | +972-54-123-4567 | alexei.morozov@nexacloudbiz.com  

Professional Summary  
A senior tech lead with 8 years of experience in SaaS product development, specializing in scalable backend systems and cloud-native architectures. Proven ability to translate business needs into technical roadmaps, while maintaining operational stability across distributed teams. Focused on optimizing performance, reducing latency, and fostering collaboration between engineering and product stakeholders.  

Professional Experience  
**NexaCloud Solutions** | Tech Lead (2020–Present)  
Led a team of 12 engineers building a multi-tenant SaaS platform for enterprise data analytics. Designed a Kubernetes-based architecture that scaled from 50 to 500 nodes, reducing deployment latency by 40%. Implemented centralized monitoring with Prometheus and Grafana, cutting incident resolution time by 30%. Spearheaded the migration of monolithic services to microservices, improving system uptime to 99.95%. Mentored junior engineers in CI/CD practices, resulting in a 50% reduction in manual testing overhead.  

**Aether Dynamics** | Senior Backend Engineer (2018–2020)  
Architected a real-time data processing pipeline using Apache Kafka and Elasticsearch, handling 10M+ events/day. Optimized PostgreSQL queries for a customer analytics dashboard, reducing query latency from 1.2s to 300ms. Built and maintained CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions, achieving 95% automated testing coverage. Collaborated with DevOps to implement automated scaling for containerized workloads, lowering infrastructure costs by 25%.  

**VeloCloud Inc.** | Backend Developer (2016–2018)  
Developed RESTful APIs for a global CDN platform, supporting 500k+ concurrent users. Pioneered Linux server automation using Ansible, reducing deployment time by 60%. Integrated third-party monitoring tools to track system health, enabling proactive maintenance and minimizing downtime.  

Technical Skills  
Linux administration: Managed Ubuntu and CentOS clusters, configured firewalls, and optimized resource allocation for high-traffic services.  
CI/CD pipelines: Owned end-to-end deployment workflows for Python and Node.js applications, reducing release cycles from weeks to days.  
Database optimization: Engineered indexing strategies and query plans for MySQL and PostgreSQL, achieving 50% faster data retrieval.  
GitHub Actions: Automated testing and deployment for 15+ microservices, ensuring 99% CI/CD pipeline reliability.  
Monitoring & alerting: Implemented Prometheus-based dashboards for real-time metrics tracking, improving incident detection by 70%.  
Agile/Scrum: Facilitated sprint planning and retrospectives for cross-functional teams, aligning technical priorities with business goals.  
Cross-team collaboration: Mediated between product, QA, and DevOps teams to resolve architecture conflicts and streamline workflows.  
Kubernetes: Designed and scaled container orchestration for stateful applications, managing persistent volumes and service meshes.  
Project management: Coordinated sprints and resource allocation, ensuring timely delivery of complex features with minimal technical debt.  
Stakeholder communication: Presented technical trade-offs to non-technical leaders, securing buy-in for architecture decisions.  
System design: Led the creation of scalable, fault-tolerant systems using service meshes and distributed databases.  
Team leadership: Mentored 5+ engineers in best practices, fostering a culture of code reviews and knowledge sharing.  

Education  
Moscow State University | Computer Science | 2015  

Languages  
English (native), Russian (fluent), Hebrew (basic)  

Certifications
